$ edit b/testdata/hypercase.json  # b's registry records another description for import
$ rm b/corpus_test.go  # remove b's tests, and leave its registry
$ go test  # chain-a
    b/testdata/hypercase.json is a registry, and b holds no _test.go file, so no test compares it, and it still claims sections.
        Delete it, or restore the package's tests.
    the transform louder, of testdata/export/, is owned by no package, so nothing writes its variants' inputs, or judges them against what it makes. The registry of ./b records that its package owns the transform, and ./b holds no _test.go file, so no test runs the transform there.
        Restore the tests of ./b, or delete its registry and give the transform to hypercase.Own in another package that registers its corpus type.
